world.title: 鸟群依靠三条局部规则形成统一运动
world.posterTitle: 三条局部规则形成鸟群运动
world.posterHook: 每只鸟只做三件小事：别撞上、跟着飞、别掉队，整群就会一起转弯。
world.posterSource: Canvas 2D · Boids 算法 · 本地构建
world.question: 没有领袖，鸟群如何飞出统一的形状？
world.hook: 每只鸟只看附近同伴：太近就让开，方向不一样就跟一点，离队太远就往回靠。没有谁需要看见整个鸟群。
world.payoff: Craig Reynolds 在 1987 年用这三条局部规则做出了 Boids。鸟群的统一形状不是领队发出的命令，而是许多次很小的避让、转向和靠近叠在一起。

en.title: Three local rules produce coordinated flocking
en.posterTitle: Three local rules produce flocking behavior
en.posterHook: Each bird does just three things: avoid collisions, follow the flow, and stay with the group. The whole flock turns together.
en.question: Without a leader, how does a flock fly in unified shapes?
en.hook: Each bird sees only nearby neighbors: move apart when too close, turn a little toward their heading, and move back when drifting away. No bird needs to see the whole flock.
en.payoff: Craig Reynolds built Boids from these three local rules in 1987. A flock’s unified shape is not an order from a leader; it is the sum of many tiny acts of avoiding, turning, and regrouping.
